column2: Recovery tables for the 14 data products
column3:
Feature: Recovery tables for the 14 data products

  Scenario: AC1 Schema deployed
    Given the migration V0001__rwb_e1_001_recovery_schema.sql and the parameter recoverySchema = "recovery"
    When the pipeline applies it in DEV and then in SIT
    Then the recovery schema in each environment holds 92 tables: the 88 Workbench tables and the four extension tables party_ext, contact_point_ext, account_ext and valuation_ext
    Then it holds none of the tables that left the schema: loan_account, account_payment, party, contact_point, collateral, account_collateral, collections_history, party_product, valuation, score, asset, load_run, dq_exception, dq_rule, source_field_map, source_code_map, interface_run, interface_signoff, tracker_inventory and tracker_row
    Then no constraint in schema recovery references a table in schema public
    Then every link to an ACE record is a varchar(255) business key with no foreign key: account_key, person_key, asset_key, payment_code and contact_key
    Then the conformance test reports 1,062 of the 1,062 table fields matched by name and physical type
    Then the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views ship separately in RWB-E1-069 and add their 304 fields to the dictionary

  Scenario: AC2 Dictionary published
    Given the data dictionary and the data product seed loaded by the migration, and the catalog loaded for DP01
    When a developer queries v_data_dictionary for entity "v_ace_account" and field "days_past_due"
    Then the row holds field ID "DF-ACE-018", data type "NUMBER", physical type "integer"
    Then source system "ACE", source field "public.account.delay_days"
    Then data product "DP01", system of record "ACE (ingested from ALS)", refresh cycle "DAILY", owner role "RW-DATASTEW" and the owner user ID of DP01
    Then the row for entity "account_ext" and field "dispute_open" holds field ID "DF-EXT-028", data type "BOOLEAN", physical type "boolean", source system "Workbench" and data product "DP01"

  Scenario: AC3 One system of record
    Given a catalog load file with the 14 rows DP01 to DP14, each with one system of record and one owner user ID
    When the reference data administrator loads it with valid from 2026-11-30
    Then data_product holds 14 rows
    Then each row has a definition, exactly one system of record and one owner user ID
    Then DP01 names system of record "ACE (ingested from ALS)" and refresh cycle "DAILY"
    Then DP03 names system of record "Recovery Workbench" and refresh cycle "ON_CHANGE"
    Then DP06 names system of record "ACE (ingested from CCMS, SVAF, AMIS and RPS)", refresh cycle "WEEKLY" and expected by "MON 08:00"

  Scenario: AC4 Failed migration leaves no partial schema
    Given a copy of the migration in which the statement creating table valuation_ext fails
    When the pipeline applies it in DEV
    Then the pipeline stage fails and names the failing statement
    Then the recovery schema holds none of the tables of that migration
    Then the Flyway history has no successful row for version 1.001

  Scenario: AC5 Column without a dictionary entry fails the build
    Given a branch that adds the column account_ext.branch_code with no sys_fields row
    When the conformance test runs in the pipeline
    Then the test fails with "account_ext.branch_code has no data dictionary entry"
    Then a sys_fields row DF-EXT-028 whose column is changed to type text fails the test with "DF-EXT-028 physical type boolean expected, text found"

  Scenario: AC6 Repeated migration has no effect
    Given the migration version 1.001 already applied in SIT
    When the pipeline runs again in SIT
    Then Flyway reports version 1.001 as already applied
    Then the row counts of sys_objects (122) and sys_fields (1,366) are unchanged

  Scenario: AC7 Catalog row with two systems of record is refused
    Given a catalog load file in which DP06 names system of record "ACE (ingested from CCMS); SVAF"
    Given DP11 has no owner user ID
    When the reference data administrator loads it
    Then the system refuses the load in full with MSG-P1-003 for DP06 and for DP11
    Then data_product keeps the rows of the version in force

  Scenario: AC8 Catalog with a missing product is refused
    Given a catalog load file with 13 rows and no row for DP09
    When the reference data administrator loads it
    Then the system refuses the load in full with MSG-P1-004 naming "DP09"
    Then the system writes no row

  Scenario: AC9 Value outside its list
    Given a catalog load file in which row 4 (DP04) names owner role "DP_OWNER" and row 5 (DP05) names refresh cycle "HOURLY"
    When the reference data administrator loads it
    Then the system refuses the load in full with MSG-P1-007 "Row 4: owner_role must be one of the role codes in LOV-ROLE." and "Row 5: refresh_cycle must be one of DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, ON_CHANGE."

  Scenario: AC10 Same catalog file loaded again
    Given the catalog version loaded on 2026-11-30 is in force
    When the reference data administrator loads the same file again
    Then the system writes nothing
    Then the response carries MSG-P1-011 "The data product catalog load for 2026-11-30 is already complete or running. It was not run again."

  Scenario: AC11 Source named on its own is refused
    Given a catalog load file in which DP06 names system of record "CCMS"
    When the reference data administrator loads it
    Then the system refuses the load in full with MSG-P1-003 "DP06 must name one system of record, written ACE (ingested from X) or Recovery Workbench, or both where the product holds both, and one named owner."
    Then no row is written and the version in force stays in use

column2: Case list v1 with case ID, owner and queue
column3:
Feature: Case list v1 with case ID, owner and queue

  Background:
    Given the business date is 2026-11-30 and v_ace_batch_status shows ALS COMPLETED for 2026-11-30
    Given the parameters case.entry.dpd = 90 and recon.caselist.tolerance.pct = 0.00 are in force

  Scenario: AC1 List built and reconciled
    Given v_ace_account holds 28,140 accounts at 90 days past due or more with data_as_of 2026-11-30
    Given P3 excluded 21 of them at entry, so the ACE count to match is 28,119
    Given the open cases link 28,119 accounts at 90 days past due or more and 37 accounts below 90 days past due
    When the case list step of JOB-04 runs
    Then case_list_row holds 28,156 rows for 2026-11-30
    Then REC-01 of RWB-E1-011 compares 28,119 with 28,119 and is PASS
    Then the run record shows 37 rows below 90 days past due

  Scenario: AC2 Columns present
    Given the case list for 2026-11-30 is built
    When the extract file for 2026-11-30 is written
    Then each row holds case number, account number, product, stage, status, owner, queue, route, total balance and days past due, in that order
    Then each row also holds team, business date and refresh time
    Then the Power BI data set "Case list v1" offers filters on team, queue and product
    Then the row for case "RW-2026-000123" shows account "ACC0000123", product "MORTGAGE", status "ASSIGNED", queue "MTG-BKK-CO", total balance 1,250,000.00 and days past due 96, the values of v_ace_account for that account_key

  Scenario: AC3 Daily refresh
    Given the ALS batch for 2026-11-30 completed at 05:40 and JOB-03 completed at 06:52
    When the case list step runs and completes at 07:12
    Then every row for 2026-11-30 carries refresh time 2026-12-01 07:12
    Then the report after the 07:30 data set refresh shows "Refreshed 1 Dec 2026 07:12, data as of 30 Nov 2026"

  Scenario: AC4 Last contact from EFS through ACE
    Given v_ace_efs_action holds an action "PTP" for an account of case "RW-2026-000123" with contact_at 2026-11-30 15:42
    When the case list step runs
    Then the row of case "RW-2026-000123" shows last contact 2026-11-30 15:42 and action code "PTP"

  Scenario: AC5 ACE batch not complete
    Given v_ace_batch_status shows no COMPLETED ALS row for 2026-11-30 at 08:00
    When the DP01 cut-off passes and JOB-04 is triggered
    Then the daily completeness gate holds the step and no case_list_row for 2026-11-30 is written
    Then the lake keeps the extract file for 2026-11-27
    Then the team manager group receives MSG-P1-001 "DP01 Account and arrears is from 2026-11-27. Today's ACE batch has not arrived."

  Scenario: AC6 Allocation not finished
    Given JOB-03 for 2026-11-30 has not completed at 07:15
    When the case list step starts at 07:15
    Then the system builds the list with the owner and queue as they are at 07:15
    Then the run record shows check ALLOCATION_COMPLETE NO
    Then the report shows "Owners and queues may be incomplete for 30 Nov 2026"

  Scenario: AC7 Run repeated for the same date
    Given the case list for 2026-11-30 holds 28,156 rows
    When the platform administrator restarts the step for 2026-11-30
    Then case_list_row still holds 28,156 rows for 2026-11-30 and no case account appears twice
    Then the refresh time is the time of the rerun

  Scenario: AC8 Case interface error
    Given CaseQueryApi raises an error after 12,000 accounts are read
    When the case list step runs
    Then the system writes no case_list_row for 2026-11-30
    Then the run status is FAILED
    Then the rows for 2026-11-27 are unchanged

  Scenario: AC9 Transfer to the lake fails
    Given the outbound file adapter fails all its retries for the 2026-11-30 extract file
    When the publish step runs with publish_status "RELEASED"
    Then the run shows COMPLETED with check PUBLISHED NO
    Then the transfer is in the exception queue with a task for the platform administrator

  Scenario: AC10 Case account without an ACE account row
    Given case "RW-2026-000456" links account_key "ACC0000456", which has no v_ace_account row for 2026-11-30
    When the case list step runs
    Then the row for "ACC0000456" has an empty account number, total balance and days past due
    Then REC-05 of RWB-E1-011 lists "case_account.account_key ACC0000456" as an orphan for the data steward and the ACE team
    Then the case and its case_account link are unchanged

  Scenario: AC11 Case list access refused
    Given user "u-owner-01" holds RW-CASEOWN and not Platform administration R
    When the user calls GET /admin/jobs?type=JOB-04
    Then the system refuses the call with status 403 and MSG-P4-002

column2: Integration adapters for outbound files
column3:
Feature: Integration adapters for outbound files

  Background:
    Given the interface configuration version "IF-2026.11" is in force
    Given interface "INT-14" WIN outbound has direction "OUTBOUND", max attempts 3 and retry intervals 5, 15 and 45 minutes
    Given interface "INT-14" has owner role "RW-PLATADM"

  Scenario: AC1 One outbound pattern
    Given a developer adds the outbound file "INT-25" debt buyer data tape
    When the build pipeline runs
    Then the system declares the file as an interface configuration row with direction "OUTBOUND" and uses OutboundFileAdapter
    Then the contract test "INT-25" builds the synthetic tape of 120 accounts from debt_sale_account and v_ace_account and passes
    Then the architecture test finds no SFTP or file system call outside the package recovery.integration.adapter
    Then no interface configuration row has direction "INBOUND"

  Scenario: AC2 Outbound file reads ACE only through the views
    Given 85 approved notices for business date 2026-11-10, each with person_key and contact_key
    When JOB-10 builds the WIN file "WIN_NOTICE_20261110.txt"
    Then each addressee and address is read from v_ace_contact by contact_key
    Then no statement of the build reads a public table
    Then the outbound item records the ACE business date 2026-11-10 from v_ace_batch_status

  Scenario: AC3 Retry and exception queue
    Given the outbound WIN file "WIN_NOTICE_20261110.txt" for 85 notices on 85 cases
    Given the SFTP transfer fails on attempts 1, 2 and 3
    When the outbox sender runs
    Then attempt 2 starts 5 minutes after attempt 1 and attempt 3 starts 15 minutes after attempt 2
    Then each case in the file moves to route state "RETRY_QUEUE" after attempt 1 (R-UNI-33)
    Then after attempt 3 the item status is "EXCEPTION"
    Then each of the 85 cases moves to route state "EXCEPTION_QUEUE" with a task for role "RW-PLATADM" (R-UNI-34)
    Then the item shows in the exception queue with message MSG-P2-001

  Scenario: AC4 Outbound file held while the ACE batch is not complete
    Given v_ace_batch_status shows the ALS batch for 2026-11-10 with status "FAILED" at 05:20
    Given the WIN notice file for 2026-11-10 is due at 16:00
    When JOB-10 reaches its build step
    Then no file is built and no outbound_item is written
    Then the request is held with the reason "DP01 Account and arrears is from 2026-11-07"
    Then the platform administrator receives MSG-P1-001 "DP01 Account and arrears is from 2026-11-07. Today's ACE batch has not arrived."
    Then the file is built by the next JOB-10 run after EV-26 for 2026-11-10

  Scenario: AC5 Duplicate application event ignored
    Given consumer "booking-confirmation" processed event key "EV-10:TRT-0001:v1"
    When the same event arrives again with the same key
    Then the consumer does not act
    Then the hit count for that key becomes 2 (R-UNI-40)

  Scenario: AC6 Two senders pick the same item
    Given outbound item "OB-0001" is due
    When two sender threads run at 10:00:00
    Then the system sends the file once
    Then the attempt count is 1

  Scenario: AC7 Resend from the exception queue
    Given outbound item "OB-0002" has status "EXCEPTION" after 3 attempts
    When a platform administrator resends it
    Then the item status is "PENDING" with attempt count 0
    Then the system writes the resend to the ACE audit log with the user and the time
    Then the response carries message MSG-GEN-005

column2: Decision log store v1, append only and hash chained
column3:
Feature: Decision log store v1, append only and hash chained

  Background:
    Given the environment is DEV with synthetic data
    Given the decision log store is empty

  Scenario: AC1 Append only
    Given an entry with chain_seq 1 and final call "OWNER_ASSIGNED" is stored for case "RW-2026-000123"
    When an UPDATE setting final_call to "CASE_TRANSFERRED" and a DELETE of the entry are attempted through the ACE service's database role and again through the schema owner role
    Then the system refuses all four statements : by the missing grant for the service role, and with "decision_log_entry is append only" from tr_declog_append_only for the schema owner
    Then the entry is unchanged
    Then the system writes the refused attempts to the ACE audit log with the table, the operation and the entry ID

  Scenario: AC2 Hash chain
    Given 100 entries are appended
    When the chain verifier runs from chain_seq 1 to 100
    Then every entry_hash equals the SHA-256 of the entry's canonical form
    Then every prev_hash equals the entry_hash of the entry before it, and the first prev_hash is 64 zeros
    Then the result holds count 100, last chain_seq 100 and that entry's entry_hash

  Scenario: AC3 Seven field groups
    Given an entry is appended for decision "D6" on case "RW-2026-000123" with rule "R-UNI-14", rule version "UNI-2026.11", inputs reference "inputs/2026-12-03/7f3a", recommendation, approver "U-6101", approval level "L6", final call "APPROVED", actions and outcome
    When it is read with GET /decision-log/{entryId}
    Then the response holds inputsRef, ruleId and ruleVersion, recommendation, approverUserId and approvalLevel, finalCall, actions and outcome
    Then decidedAt, prevHash and entryHash are present

  Scenario: AC4 Hash chain verified daily
    Given the store holds 10,000 entries
    Given the actions of the entry with chain_seq 7,412 were changed in the DEV database with the trigger disabled
    When the chain verifier runs from chain_seq 1 to 10,000
    Then the result names chain_seq 7,412 and its entry ID as the first break
    Then the system raises an incident and MSG-P7-008 is sent to the Compliance group within 15 minutes of the run start

  Scenario: AC5 Two appends at the same moment form one chain
    Given entries up to chain_seq 50 are stored
    When two writers append one entry each in parallel transactions
    Then the entries get chain_seq 51 and 52
    Then the prev_hash of 52 equals the entry_hash of 51, and the prev_hash of 51 equals the entry_hash of 50

  Scenario: AC6 A correction is a new entry
    Given entry "E-1" records owner "U-6102" by mistake
    When a correction entry is appended with corrects_entry_id "E-1" and the right owner "U-6103"
    Then entry "E-1" is unchanged
    Then GET /decision-log for case "RW-2026-000123" returns both entries in chain order with the correction naming "E-1"

  Scenario: AC7 A failed append leaves nothing behind
    Given the database connection for the store is closed in the test double
    When a writer appends an entry inside a transaction that also changes the case owner
    Then the system raises decisionLogUnavailableException
    Then the system stores no entry , the case owner is unchanged and chain_seq is not used

  Scenario: AC8 Reading an entry needs the Decision log right
    Given test user "U-6104" holds only RW-PHONECOL, whose Decision log letter is "-"
    When the user calls GET /decision-log/{entryId}
    Then the system refuses the call with status 403 and message MSG-P4-002

column2: Reconciliation and data quality report
column3:
Feature: Reconciliation and data quality report

  Background:
    Given the business date is 2026-11-30 and v_ace_batch_status shows ALS COMPLETED for 2026-11-30
    Given the parameter recon.tolerance.pct = 0.00 is in force for REC-01 and REC-02

  Scenario: AC1 Variance under limit
    Given the v_ace_account accounts at 90 days past due or more less the exclusions are MORTGAGE 12,256, HIRE_PURCHASE 12,960 and SSME 2,903
    Given the case list rows at 90 days past due or more are MORTGAGE 12,256, HIRE_PURCHASE 12,960 and SSME 2,903, with equal balance sums
    Given no restructure plan is overdue in v_ace_plan, no payment of the date is unmatched, and every business key resolves to its view
    When the reconciliation step of JOB-04 runs
    Then the system writes fifteen reconciliation_result rows, REC-01 to REC-05 for each of the three product groups, each with variance 0 and result PASS
    Then the system sets the publish status of the case list for 2026-11-30 to RELEASED
    Then the report after the 07:30 refresh shows all three products green

  Scenario: AC2 Variance over limit
    Given v_ace_account holds 2,903 SSME accounts at 90 days past due or more less the exclusions
    Given the case list holds 2,891 SSME rows at 90 days past due or more, a variance of 12 accounts, 0.41 percent
    When the reconciliation step runs
    Then the REC-01 result for SSME is BREAK with variance 12 and variance percent 0.41
    Then the 12 account keys are on the break list for the data steward, with their days past due from v_ace_account
    Then the system sets the case list publish for 2026-11-30 to HELD and the lake keeps the case list of 2026-11-27
    Then the data steward, platform administrator and team manager groups receive MSG-P1-012 "The case list for 2026-11-30 does not reconcile to ACE for SSME: a difference of 12 accounts, 0.41 percent."
    Then the report shows SSME red with the 12 break rows, and MORTGAGE and HIRE_PURCHASE green

  Scenario: AC3 Variance equal to the tolerance
    Given the parameter recon.tolerance.pct for REC-01 is changed by a reference load to 0.10 from 2026-11-30
    Given the MORTGAGE variance is 0.10 percent and the SSME variance is 0.11 percent
    When the reconciliation step runs
    Then the MORTGAGE result is PASS and the SSME result is BREAK

  Scenario: AC4 ACE batch not complete
    Given v_ace_batch_status shows no COMPLETED ALS row for 2026-11-30 at 08:00
    When the DP01 cut-off passes and JOB-04 is triggered
    Then the daily completeness gate holds JOB-04 and the system writes no reconciliation_result for 2026-11-30
    Then the case list publish for 2026-11-30 stays HELD
    Then the report shows every product as not run with the reason "DP01 is from 2026-11-27"

  Scenario: AC5 Rerun after a fix
    Given the SSME result for 2026-11-30 is BREAK and the publish is held
    Given P3 has created the 12 missing cases and the case list step has been rerun
    When the platform administrator restarts the reconciliation step for 2026-11-30
    Then the system replaces the fifteen results for 2026-11-30 and all are PASS
    Then the system sets the publish status of the date to RELEASED and the case list extract is sent to the lake

  Scenario: AC6 Two runs for the same date
    Given two JOB-04 runs for 2026-11-30 start on two nodes
    When both reach the reconciliation step
    Then reconciliation_result holds one row per check and product group, fifteen rows in all
    Then no row is written twice for the same rec_code, business_date and product_group

  Scenario: AC7 Business key without an ACE row
    Given case_party on case "RW-2026-000140" carries person_key "P0099881", which has no row in v_ace_customer
    When the REC-05 step runs
    Then the REC-05 result for the product group of the case is BREAK with 1 orphan
    Then "case_party.person_key P0099881" is on the break list for the data steward and the ACE team
    Then the case and its case_party row are unchanged

  Scenario: AC8 View unavailable during the run
    Given v_ace_account returns an error after the MORTGAGE count is read
    When the reconciliation step runs
    Then the system writes no reconciliation_result for 2026-11-30
    Then the run shows FAILED with MSG-GEN-006 for system "ACE database"
    Then the restart writes all fifteen rows for 2026-11-30

column2: Baseline measures
column3:
Feature: Baseline measures

  Background:
    Given the synthetic case set for business date 2026-11-27 holds 120 open cases: 60 Mortgage, 45 Hire purchase and 15 SSME
    Given age bands are "0-90", "91-180", "181-365", "366-730" and "over 730" days since entry

  Scenario: AC1 Definitions agreed
    Given a definition file of 6 rows for "CASES_BY_ROUTE", "CASES_BY_AGE", "CASES_BY_QUEUE", "REALIZED_RECOVERY", "TIME_IN_STAGE" and "TAT_BY_ROUTE"
    Given each row names its data product, formula, unit and approver "TRB-0001" with approval date 2026-11-20
    When it is loaded with valid from 2026-11-21
    Then definition version "MD-2026.11" is in force with 6 measures
    Then each measure returns its data product and formula through MeasureCatalog

  Scenario: AC2 Baseline published
    Given v_ace_batch_status holds a COMPLETED ALS row for business date 2026-11-27
    When JOB-15 runs at 01:30 on 2026-11-28
    Then measure_snapshot holds rows for business date 2026-11-27 marked baseline and frozen with definition version "MD-2026.11"
    Then "CASES_BY_ROUTE" totals 120 cases, of which 60 are Mortgage
    Then "REALIZED_RECOVERY" equals the sum of synthetic payments since entry, 4,350,000.00 THB

  Scenario: AC3 Power BI data set
    Given the baseline measures are published
    When JOB-15 runs at 01:30 on 2026-12-02
    Then the INT-19 extract for business date 2026-12-01 is in the data lake with freshness stamp 2026-12-01 and the record count in its trailer
    Then the extract holds the baseline rows of 2026-11-27 unchanged
    Then the job monitor records the JOB-15 run with its row count, start and end time

  Scenario: AC4 Definition without a formula refused
    Given a definition file where row "TIME_IN_STAGE" has no formula
    When it is loaded
    Then the system refuses the load in full with MSG-GEN-001 naming "formula"
    Then the system puts no definition version in force

  Scenario: AC5 Baseline published twice
    Given the baseline for 2026-11-27 is frozen
    When JOB-15 is rerun for business date 2026-11-27 from SCR-44
    Then the frozen rows are unchanged
    Then the run record shows MSG-P9-001 naming 2026-11-27

  Scenario: AC6 Batch of the baseline date not complete
    Given v_ace_batch_status holds no COMPLETED ALS row for business date 2026-11-27
    When JOB-15 runs at 01:30 on 2026-11-28
    Then the system writes no baseline rows for 2026-11-27
    Then the run record shows MSG-P1-001 naming "DP03 Case" and 2026-11-26
    Then the system publishes the baseline by the first JOB-15 run after the ALS batch for 2026-11-27 is COMPLETED

  Scenario: AC7 Data lake unavailable
    Given the data lake load area does not answer
    When JOB-15 runs at 01:30 on 2026-12-01
    Then the system writes measure_snapshot rows for 2026-11-30 in the Workbench
    Then the system holds the extract and an alert goes to the operations channel with MSG-GEN-006 naming "Data lake"
    Then the system sends the extract by the next JOB-15 run

  Scenario: AC8 Measure with no definition in force
    Given the extract configuration lists measure "COST_PER_CASE" with no definition in force
    When JOB-15 runs at 01:30 on 2026-11-30
    Then the system writes no value for "COST_PER_CASE"
    Then the run record shows MSG-P9-003 naming "COST_PER_CASE"

column2: Decision log copy to the data lake
column3:
Feature: Decision log copy to the data lake

  Background:
    Given the live decision log holds 12,480 entries with last entry hash "a3f1...09c2"
    Given the watermark shows 12,100 entries copied with last hash "77be...41d0"
    Given the retention rule for DP12 record class LAKE_COPY is 24 months, rule version "RET-2026.11"

  Scenario: AC1 Daily copy
    Given 380 entries were written on business date 2026-11-30
    When JOB-13 runs at 01:00 on 2026-12-01
    Then the partition "business_date=2026-11-30" holds 380 rows
    Then the manifest shows cumulative count 12,480 and last hash "a3f1...09c2"
    Then the data lake copy has the same row count and the same last hash as the live log
    Then the watermark moves to 12,480 and "a3f1...09c2"

  Scenario: AC2 Retention rule
    Given lake partitions for business dates 2024-11-29 and 2024-11-30 exist
    When the retention step of JOB-13 runs on 2026-12-01
    Then the partitions "business_date=2024-11-29" and "business_date=2024-11-30" move to the archive tier
    Then the job run records 2 partitions archived under rule version "RET-2026.11"

  Scenario: AC3 A copy that does not match is not published
    Given the lake write for 2026-11-30 stops after 379 of 380 rows
    When the reconciliation step compares the copy with the live log
    Then the system does not mark the partition complete
    Then the watermark stays at 12,100 and "77be...41d0"
    Then the job run shows check "REC-08" failed with MSG-P1-019

  Scenario: AC4 A repeat run for the same date writes no duplicates
    Given JOB-13 completed for 2026-11-30 with 380 rows
    When JOB-13 is rerun for 2026-11-30
    Then the partition "business_date=2026-11-30" still holds 380 rows
    Then the cumulative count stays 12,480

  Scenario: AC5 The decision log interface is unavailable
    Given DecisionLogExport returns an error for every call
    When JOB-13 runs for 2026-11-30
    Then the job run ends with status "FAILED" and MSG-GEN-006 for system "Decision log"
    Then the watermark and the previous partitions are unchanged

  Scenario: AC6 A day with no new decisions
    Given no entry was written after "77be...41d0"
    When JOB-13 runs for 2026-11-30
    Then the partition holds 0 rows and the manifest shows cumulative count 12,100
    Then check "REC-08" passes

  Scenario: AC7 Two runs at the same time
    Given JOB-13 is running for 2026-11-30
    When a platform administrator posts a rerun of JOB-13
    Then the system refuses the rerun with status 409 and MSG-P2-006
    Then one run continues

  Scenario: AC8 A partition exactly at its retention age is kept
    Given a lake partition for business date 2024-12-01
    When the retention step runs on 2026-12-01
    Then the partition "business_date=2024-12-01" stays in the copy

column2: Freshness stamp per data product
column3:
Feature: Freshness stamp per data product

  Background:
    Given data product "DP01" Account and arrears has refresh cycle "DAILY" and expected-by time 08:00

column2: Allocation and assignment engine v1
column3:
Feature: Allocate a new recovery case to a queue and an owner

  Background:
    Given package ALLOCATION version "ALLOC-2026.11" is in force from 2026-11-30
    Given package ASSIGNMENT version "ASSIGN-2026.11" is in force and gives queue "MTG-BKK-CO" the method "ROUND_ROBIN" with a caseload cap of 150
    Given the queue "MTG-BKK-CO" belongs to team "MTG-BKK" and role RW-CASEOWN
    Given the queue "MTG-BKK-CO" has the overflow queue "MTG-BKK-OVF"
    Given the business date is 2026-12-01

  Scenario: AC1 A new case is placed in the queue its rule names
    Given a new case RW-2026-000201 with status "NEW", product group "MORTGAGE", region "BKK" and exposure band "B2"
    Given allocation rule "ALLOC-014" matches product group "MORTGAGE", region "BKK" and any exposure band, with target queue "MTG-BKK-CO"
    When the morning allocation run starts
    Then the system places the case in queue "MTG-BKK-CO"
    Then the case team is "MTG-BKK" and the region is "BKK"

  Scenario: AC2 The owner is chosen by the assignment rule
    Given queue "MTG-BKK-CO" holds three case owners U-01, U-02 and U-03 with 120, 95 and 140 open cases
    Given the last owner given a case in the queue was U-02
    When case RW-2026-000201 is placed in the queue
    Then the system gives the case to U-03
    Then the case status becomes "ASSIGNED"
    Then the system writes an assignment record with reason "ALLOCATION", allocation rule ID "ALLOC-014" and assignment rule ID "ASSIGN-007"

  Scenario: AC3 An owner at the caseload cap is skipped
    Given the last owner given a case was U-02
    Given U-03, the next owner in turn, holds 150 open cases
    Given U-01 holds 120 open cases
    When case RW-2026-000202 is placed in the queue
    Then the system gives the case to U-01, the following owner below the cap

  Scenario: AC4 Every owner is at the cap
    Given U-01, U-02 and U-03 each hold 150 open cases
    When case RW-2026-000203 is placed in queue "MTG-BKK-CO"
    Then the system places the case in the overflow queue "MTG-BKK-OVF"
    Then the case status stays "NEW" and no owner is set
    Then the team manager of "MTG-BKK" receives the allocation summary with MSG-P3-011 and count 1

  Scenario: AC5 No allocation rule matches
    Given a new case RW-2026-000204 with product group "SSME" and region "NE3" that matches no allocation rule
    When the morning allocation run starts
    Then the system places the case in the exception queue "RWB-EXC"
    Then the case status stays "NEW"
    Then the system writes a decision log entry with final call "RULE_GAP", product group "SSME" and region "NE3"
    Then the system publishes caseAllocationFailed with reason "NO_ROW_MATCHED"
    Then the allocation summary carries MSG-P3-012 with count 1

  Scenario: AC6 Every allocation is logged
    Given case RW-2026-000205 matches rule "ALLOC-014" and owner U-02 is below the cap
    When the case is placed in the queue and given an owner

    Given a hire purchase case RW-2026-000405 with an account that has no last payment date and contract date 2025-06-30
    When the case is created
    Then the prescription date is 2027-06-30

  Scenario: AC7 Missed timer check runs
    Given JOB-05 did not run from 10:00 to 10:40 and three timers passed expires_at in that time
    When JOB-05 runs at 10:45
    Then the system raises three breaches, one for each timer

  Scenario: AC8 A breach is raised once
    Given the SERVICE_LEVEL timer of case RW-2026-000406 is EXPIRED with escalation level 1
    When JOB-05 runs again
    Then the system publishes no second TimerBreached for the timer
    Then escalation level stays 1

  Scenario: AC9 Decision log unavailable at a breach
    Given the decision log store is unavailable
    When the SERVICE_LEVEL timer of case RW-2026-000407 passes expires_at
    Then the timer stays RUNNING with escalation level 0
    Then the job record carries MSG-P7-003 for the timer
    Then the system raises the breach by the first run after the store is back

    Given case RW-2026-000408 has a RUNNING SERVICE_LEVEL timer and a PRESCRIPTION timer

    Given case RW-2026-000409 has a RUNNING SERVICE_LEVEL timer
    When CaseStateChanged moves the case to queue "NPA-BKK-CO" and DeviationRaised arrives on the same day
    Then TimerStarter cancels the old timer through TimerScheduler.cancel and schedules the new timer through TimerScheduler.schedule

    When they are processed by JOB-12 with 4 workers
    Then all 125 items reach "DONE" or "RESCAN" within 60 minutes of the first item starting

  Scenario: AC3 Unreadable page on a known case

Feature: Field extraction for the six types into the index

  Background:
    Given DOCTYPE-2026.11 is in force
    Given COURT_NOTICE lists court_name (text), black_case_no (text, pattern two to four letters, a space, digits, "/" and four digits), notice_date (date) and hearing_date (date)
    Given EXTRACT_FIELD_THRESHOLD is 0.80

  Scenario: AC1 Fields extracted
    Given intake item "IN-0001" classified "COURT_NOTICE" with confidence 0.9400
    Given its OCR text holds court "Civil Court", black case number "Por 1234/2569", notice date "1 December 2569 BE" and hearing date "15 December 2569 BE"
    When extractStep runs
    Then extracted_fields of "IN-0001" holds court_name "Civil Court" 0.9600, black_case_no "Por 1234/2569" 0.9100, notice_date "2026-12-01" 0.9000 and hearing_date "2026-12-15" 0.8800, each with state "OK" and extractor version "EXT-TPL-1.0"
    Then extract_status is "DONE"
    Then when matchStep stores the document on case "RW-2026-000123" the four fields are in the index and review_status is "NOT_NEEDED"

  Scenario: AC2 Precision and recall
    Given the labeled sample of 180 documents and the pass marks precision 0.90 and recall 0.90 per field
    When the extraction evaluation run processes the sample
    Then the report lists precision and recall for each of the 26 fields with the extractor version
    Then the system lists TITLE_DEED area_sq_wa with precision 0.84 as "review-only"
    Then the run writes a proposed DOCTYPE load file with review_only true for area_sq_wa only
    Then the version in force does not change until the proposed version is loaded and approved

  Scenario: AC3 A field below the threshold goes to review
    Given intake item "IN-0002" classified "COURT_NOTICE"
    Given the extractor returns hearing_date with confidence 0.6200
    When extractStep runs
    Then hearing_date has state "REVIEW" and the other three fields state "OK"
    Then when the document is stored its review_status is "PENDING" and SCR-30 shows MSG-P5-003

  Scenario: AC4 A review-only field always goes to review
    Given TITLE_DEED field area_sq_wa has review_only true
    Given the extractor returns area_sq_wa "940" with confidence 0.9900 on item "IN-0003"
    When extractStep runs
    Then area_sq_wa has state "REVIEW"

  Scenario: AC5 Confidence equal to the threshold passes
    Given the extractor returns black_case_no on item "IN-0004" with confidence 0.8000
    When extractStep runs
    Then black_case_no has state "OK"

  Scenario: AC6 A value that cannot be converted goes to review
    Given the OCR text of item "IN-0005" holds hearing date "32 December 2569 BE"
    When extractStep runs
    Then hearing_date keeps the value "32 December 2569 BE" with confidence 0.0000 and state "REVIEW"

  Scenario: AC7 The extracted case number and account number are given to matchStep
    Given intake item "IN-0006" classified "DEMAND_LETTER" whose text holds case "RW-2026-000123" and an account number
    When extractStep runs
    Then extracted_fields holds case_no "RW-2026-000123" and account_no
    Then the system marks account_no personal and is not written to the job record or the logs

  Scenario: AC8 The extractor does not answer
    Given the extractor does not answer within 60 seconds on 3 attempts for item "IN-0007"
    When extractStep runs
    Then extract_status is "FAILED" and review_reason is "EXTRACTION_FAILED"
    Then extracted_fields is empty
    Then matchStep does not attach "IN-0007"

  Scenario: AC9 A repeated run has no effect
    Given item "IN-0001" has extract_status "DONE"
    When extractStep runs again
    Then the system does not read "IN-0001" again and extracted_fields is unchanged

  Scenario: AC10 Two workers on the same item
    Given two extractStep workers start at the same time
    When both select item "IN-0008"
    Then one worker extracts it and the other skips it
    Then "IN-0008" has one set of fields

  Scenario: AC11 A new version of an uploaded document
    Given uploaded court notice "DOC-0001" has four active document_field rows from version 1
    Given version 2 of "DOC-0001" is added with hearing date "20 January 2570 BE"
    When extractStep runs on the intake item for version 2
    Then the system writes four new active rows with hearing_date "2027-01-20"
    Then the four version 1 rows have is_active false and stay readable
    Then one DocumentFieldsExtracted event is in the outbox for "DOC-0001"

  Scenario: AC12 An English document is extracted
    Given item "IN-0009" classified "APPRAISAL_REPORT" with English text holding appraisal number "AP-2026-0457", date "3 October 2026" and value "THB 4,250,000"
    When extractStep runs
    Then appraisal_no is "AP-2026-0457", appraisal_date is "2026-10-03" and appraised_value is "4250000.00"

  Scenario: AC13 A document outside the caller's scope
    Given a case owner whose scope is team "MTG-BKK"
    Given document "DOC-0010" belongs to a case in team "HP-NE"
    When the case owner calls GET /api/recovery/v1/documents/DOC-0010
    Then the response is 404 with MSG-P4-003 and no field value is returned

column2: Review queue for low-confidence documents
column3:
Feature: Review queue for low-confidence documents

  Background:
    Given DOCTYPE-2026.11 is in force and the classify_threshold of every type is 0.8000
    Given REVIEW_TEAM_UNATTACHED is "LIT-BKK" for this test
    Given a litigation officer with role RW-LITOFF in team "LIT-BKK" with team scope

  Scenario: AC1 Queued
    Given intake item "IN-0101" on which classification returned "COURT_NOTICE" 0.6200 and "DEMAND_LETTER" 0.2100
    Given its review_reason is "LOW_CONFIDENCE"
    When the officer opens SCR-31
    Then the system lists "IN-0101" with reason "LOW_CONFIDENCE" and the candidates "COURT_NOTICE 0.62" and "DEMAND_LETTER 0.21"

  Scenario: AC2 Corrected
    Given intake item "IN-0101" in the review queue with hearing_date "2026-12-15" in state "REVIEW"
    When the officer sets type "COURT_NOTICE", corrects hearing_date to "2026-12-16", confirms the other fields, chooses case "RW-2026-000201" and chooses Attach
    Then the system stores a document on "RW-2026-000201" with type "COURT_NOTICE" and hearing_date field_value "2026-12-16", extracted_value "2026-12-15", state "CORRECTED" and confirmed_by the officer's user ID
    Then the document review_status is "CORRECTED" and "IN-0101" has review_outcome "ATTACHED"
    Then the store writes one DOCATT decision log entry
    Then LabeledSetReader returns "IN-0101" with predicted type, confirmed type, extracted value and corrected value

  Scenario: AC3 A stored document with a field to check
    Given document "DOC-0103" on case "RW-2026-000202" has black_case_no "Por 2001/2569" in state "REVIEW" and review_status "PENDING"
    When the officer chooses Confirm on black_case_no and completes the review
    Then black_case_no has state "CONFIRMED" and confirmed_by the officer's user ID
    Then the document review_status is "CONFIRMED"

  Scenario: AC4 An empty correction is refused
    Given document "DOC-0103" has court_name in state "REVIEW"
    When the officer chooses Correct on court_name with an empty value
    Then the response is 422 with MSG-GEN-001 naming "Court name"
    Then court_name is unchanged

  Scenario: AC5 A type not in the list is refused
    Given intake item "IN-0104" in the review queue
    When the officer sets the type to "PAYSLIP"
    Then the response is 422 with MSG-P5-006 naming "PAYSLIP"

  Scenario: AC6 A date outside the allowed range is refused
    Given REVIEW_DATE_MIN is 2000-01-01 and REVIEW_DATE_MAX is 2100-12-31
    When the officer corrects hearing_date on "IN-0101" to "2569-12-16"
    Then the response is 422 with MSG-GEN-002 naming "Hearing date", "2000-01-01" and "2100-12-31"

  Scenario: AC7 Attach with a field still in review is refused
    Given intake item "IN-0105" has two fields in state "REVIEW" and the officer has confirmed one
    When the officer chooses Attach
    Then the response is 422 with MSG-GEN-001 naming the field still in review
    Then the system stores no document

  Scenario: AC8 A closed case is refused
    Given intake item "IN-0106" with review_reason "CASE_CLOSED" and candidate case "RW-2026-000150" with status "Closed"
    When the officer chooses case "RW-2026-000150" and chooses Attach
    Then the response is 422 with MSG-P5-005 naming "RW-2026-000150"
    Then the system stores no document

  Scenario: AC9 Two officers on the same item
    Given two officers opened intake item "IN-0107" at version 3
    Given the first officer attached it, so the item is at version 4
    When the second officer chooses Attach with version 3
    Then the response is 409 with MSG-GEN-004
    Then one document exists for "IN-0107"

  Scenario: AC10 A type change re-runs extraction for the new type
    Given intake item "IN-0108" was classified "DEMAND_LETTER" with five extracted fields
    When the officer sets the type to "GUARANTOR_NOTICE"
    Then extraction runs for "GUARANTOR_NOTICE" and the item shows its four fields, each in state "REVIEW"
    Then the DEMAND_LETTER fields are no longer offered

  Scenario: AC11 The file is already on the chosen case
    Given document "DOC-0109" on case "RW-2026-000203" holds a file with hash "H109"
    Given intake item "IN-0109" holds the same file
    When the officer attaches "IN-0109" to "RW-2026-000203"
    Then the system stores no second document and "IN-0109" is linked to "DOC-0109"
    Then the screen shows MSG-P5-024 naming "DOC-0109"

  Scenario: AC12 Discard an unreadable item
    Given intake item "IN-0110" with review_reason "UNREADABLE_FILE"
    When the officer chooses Discard with reason "Blank page from the branch scanner"
    Then "IN-0110" has review_outcome "DISCARDED" with the reason, the officer's user ID and the time
    Then it leaves the queue and no document is stored

  Scenario: AC13 Discard without a reason is refused
    Given intake item "IN-0112" with review_reason "RESCAN"
    When the officer chooses Discard with an empty reason
    Then the response is 422 with MSG-GEN-001 naming "Reason"
    Then "IN-0112" stays in the queue

  Scenario: AC14 The queue lists items in scope, oldest first
    Given 3 review items for team "LIT-BKK" received on 2 November, 4 November and 3 November
    Given 2 review items of team "HP-NE"
    When the officer opens SCR-31
    Then 3 items show, in the order 2 November, 3 November, 4 November
    Then no item of team "HP-NE" shows

  Scenario: AC15 An empty queue
    Given no review item for team "LIT-BKK"
    When the officer opens SCR-31
    Then the screen shows the empty state "No documents are waiting for review."

  Scenario: AC16 A document outside the officer's scope
    Given document "DOC-0111" belongs to a case of team "HP-NE"
    When the officer calls GET /api/recovery/v1/documents/DOC-0111
    Then the response is 404 with MSG-P4-003

  Scenario: AC17 The same confirmation sent twice
    Given the officer confirmed black_case_no on "DOC-0103"
    When the same PATCH with confirmed true and the same value arrives again
    Then the response is 200 with the saved field
    Then confirmed_by and updated_at are unchanged

column2: Proof of delivery capture design with WIN
column3:
Feature: Proof of delivery capture design with WIN

  Background:
    Given the dispatch-eligible notice states are "GENERATED"
    Given notice "N-0001" for case "RC-2026-000123" is in state "Generated" with notice type "DEMAND" and primary account contract "CT-77001"

  Scenario: AC1 Dispatched
    Given JOB-10 runs at 16:00 on 2026-11-25
    When WIN acknowledges the file with sent date 26112026, barcode "RR123456789TH" and sent type "NPL" for contract "CT-77001"
    Then notice "N-0001" has state "Sent", sent date 2026-11-26 and barcode "RR123456789TH"
    Then the interaction ledger has an outbound "LETTER" entry for case "RC-2026-000123" on 2026-11-26
    Then the system writes noticeDispatched to the outbox with notice "N-0001", barcode "RR123456789TH" and sent date 2026-11-26
    Then the case record shows MSG-P6-004 "DEMAND was sent for registered mail on 26 November 2026."

  Scenario: AC2 Proof of delivery
    Given notice "N-0001" is "Sent" with barcode "RR123456789TH"
    When v_ace_pod holds a row for 2026-11-30 with barcode "RR123456789TH" and callback_date 2026-11-28
    Then notice "N-0001" has state "Delivered", delivery status "DELIVERED" and callback date 2026-11-28
    Then the system writes noticeDelivered to the outbox with delivered date 2026-11-28
    Then case "RC-2026-000123" has a running "NOTICE_PERIOD" timer started on 2026-11-28

  Scenario: AC3 Interface contract agreed with WIN
    Given the sample INT-15 file "WIN-POD-SAMPLE-v1" of 25 records supplied by the WIN owner
    When ACE ingests it and the Workbench reads v_ace_pod
    Then all 25 rows are present in v_ace_pod with 0 refused
    Then v_ace_batch_status holds source "WIN" with feed_version "WIN-POD-SAMPLE-v1" for the business date

  Scenario: AC4 File not acknowledged
    Given the WIN file of 2026-11-25 holding "N-0001" is not acknowledged
    When JOB-10 runs on 2026-11-26, 2026-11-27 and 2026-11-28 and none is acknowledged
    Then the system sends "N-0001" in each of the three files and stays "Generated"
    Then after the third failure a task is raised to the litigation officer team with MSG-GEN-006 naming "WIN"

  Scenario: AC5 The WIN batch fails its check in ACE
    Given the ACE batch for source "WIN" of 2026-11-30 has status "FAILED" at its record count check
    When the proof of delivery for 2026-11-30 is read
    Then the system reads no v_ace_pod row for that date and no notice changes state
    Then the notice data product shows MSG-P1-001 naming "DP07 Legal" and 2026-11-23

  Scenario: AC6 Unknown reference held
    Given v_ace_pod holds 30 rows for 2026-11-30 and 1 row has barcode "RR000000000TH" and notice_ref "WIN-99999" matching no notice
    When the proof of delivery is read
    Then 29 notices update their delivery fields
    Then the system holds 1 row on the exception list with check "References"

  Scenario: AC7 The same proof of delivery read twice
    Given the v_ace_pod rows for business date 2026-11-30 have been read
    When the same rows are read again
    Then one delivery is recorded per notice and the repeat is counted under rule R-UNI-40
    Then no notice changes state a second time

  Scenario: AC8 Repeated dispatch run
    Given JOB-10 has written notice "N-0001" in the file of 2026-11-25
    When JOB-10 is rerun on 2026-11-25 from the job monitor
    Then the second file does not hold "N-0001"

  Scenario: AC9 Barcode missing after three days
    Given notice "N-0002" was in the file of 2026-11-25 and no barcode has returned
    When the daily reconciliation REC-05 runs on 2026-11-28
    Then the system lists "N-0002" as a break for the platform administrator on SCR-45

  Scenario: AC10 Repeated delivery record
    Given notice "N-0001" is "Delivered" with callback date 2026-11-28
    When v_ace_pod holds a second row with barcode "RR123456789TH" and callback_date 2026-11-28
    Then the notice is unchanged
    Then the system writes no second NoticeDelivered
    Then the system counts the repeat under rule R-UNI-40

  Scenario: AC11 Proof of delivery batch late
    Given the WIN batch due on 2026-11-30 is not COMPLETE on 2026-12-01
    When a litigation officer opens case "RC-2026-000123" on 2026-12-01
    Then the notice section shows MSG-P1-001 naming "DP07 Legal" and 2026-11-23

column2: Run books and monitoring for every Epic 1 Workbench job
column3:
Feature: Run books and monitoring for every Epic 1 Workbench job

  Background:
    Given job_catalog holds 16 rows with first release "E1": JOB-02, JOB-03, JOB-04, JOB-05, JOB-06, JOB-07, JOB-08, JOB-10, JOB-11, JOB-12, JOB-13, JOB-14, JOB-15, JOB-17, AGT-01 and CHK-01
    Given the daily case list chain is JOB-02, then JOB-03, JOB-04, JOB-07 and JOB-08, with JOB-05 every five minutes

  Scenario: AC1 Run book present
    Given the 16 rows in job_catalog
    When RunbookCompletenessTest runs in the pipeline
    Then each of the 16 jobs has a file in docs/operations/runbooks
    Then each file has the sections purpose, schedule, owner, dependencies, failure signs, checks, restart steps and escalation
    Then every run book of a job that reads ACE names v_ace_batch_status in Dependencies and the stale marker and EV-27 AceDataLate in Failure signs
    Then the run book for CHK-01 names the view conformance check and the dictionary load through RWB-E1-043 in Checks and Restart steps
    Then no file names an inbound load job, a file arrival, a load rerun, a data quality exception console or a table in schema public

  Scenario: AC2 Restart by run book
    Given JOB-02 failed at 05:40 on business date 2026-11-30 at its case creation step, because v_ace_account returned no row for an account at 90 days past due
    When a platform administrator follows the restart steps, confirms in v_ace_batch_status that ALS is COMPLETED for 2026-11-30, and calls POST /admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun at 06:05
    Then JOB-02 restarts from its failed step and ends with status "COMPLETED" at 06:20
    Then JOB-03 runs after JOB-02 and the case list shows the cases with data as of 2026-11-30
    Then the run records no developer action

  Scenario: AC3 Monitoring in place
    Given every job in job_catalog ran at least once in SIT
    When the platform administrator opens the workbook "Recovery jobs"
    Then each of the 16 jobs shows its last run time, status and duration
    Then the workbook shows the last complete ACE business date per source from v_ace_batch_status beside the jobs
    Then GET /admin/jobs returns the same last run, status, startedAt and endedAt for each job
    Then GET /admin/scheduled-jobs returns 16 entries with owner role, schedule, run book path and alert threshold

  Scenario: AC4 Missing run book blocks the build
    Given a developer adds a Quartz job "JOB-20" with a run book that has no "Escalation" section
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the build fails with message MSG-P2-005 naming job "JOB-20" and section "Escalation"

  Scenario: AC5 Rerun while running refused
    Given JOB-04 started at 06:40 and is running
    When a platform administrator calls POST /admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun for JOB-04 at 06:45
    Then the response is 409 with message MSG-P2-006
    Then JOB-04 continues its run

  Scenario: AC6 Job running past its threshold
    Given JOB-02 has an alert threshold of 45 minutes (assumed; DL11)
    When JOB-02 has run for 46 minutes on business date 2026-12-01
    Then the data steward group and the platform administrator group receive message MSG-P2-004
    Then the system does not stop JOB-02

  Scenario: AC7 Rerun of a completed job changes nothing
    Given JOB-04 completed for business date 2026-12-01
    When a platform administrator reruns it for the same date
    Then the response is 409 with message MSG-GEN-004
    Then case_list_row still holds one row per case account for 2026-12-01
    Then reconciliation_result still holds one row per product group for 2026-12-01

  Scenario: AC8 A late ACE batch holds the job
    Given v_ace_batch_status shows EFS for business date 2026-12-01 with status "FAILED" at 05:20
    When the freshness step runs
    Then data_product_load marks DP05 Contact and promises "STALE" at 05:20 and EV-27 AceDataLate is published
    Then the case list step of JOB-04 does not start for 2026-12-01 and its run is recorded "WAITING"
    Then the run book for JOB-04 says to wait for the EFS batch and not to rerun JOB-04
    Then when the EFS batch completes at 08:40, the daily gate returns COMPLETE and JOB-04 starts for 2026-12-01

  Scenario: AC9 The view conformance test has a run book
    Given a branch adds column "legacy_bucket" to recovery.v_ace_account with no sys_fields row
    When the pipeline runs CHK-01
    Then CHK-01 fails with "v_ace_account.legacy_bucket has no data dictionary entry"
    Then the merge is blocked
    Then the run book for CHK-01 gives the fix: load the dictionary row through RWB-E1-043 and rerun CHK-01

column2: Intake from branches, mailroom, partner SFTP and email
column3:
Feature: Intake from branches, mailroom, partner SFTP and email

  Background:
    Given JOB-12 Document intake runs every 15 minutes from 08:00 to 18:00 Asia/Bangkok on working days
    Given INTAKE_ALLOWED_TYPES is PDF, JPG and PNG and INTAKE_MAX_FILE_MB is 25
    Given partner "LF-007" is a law firm with panel_status "ACTIVE"

  Scenario: AC1 Branch scan
    Given file "scan-0001.pdf" of 1.2 MB in the scanner folder of branch "BR-0123", created by the scanner at 2026-11-30 09:12
    When the intake job runs at 09:15
    Then one document_intake row has source "SCAN", channel_code "BR-0123", captured_at 2026-11-30 09:12 and an empty scan_result
    Then the file is in the intake container at the row's intake_ref
    Then the file is no longer in the scanner folder and is in its processed folder

  Scenario: AC2 Partner SFTP
    Given file "LF-007-notice-0001.pdf" in the SFTP inbound subfolder "LF-007"
    When the job runs
    Then one document_intake row has source "PARTNER", channel_code "LF-007" and partner_id of partner "LF-007"

  Scenario: AC3 Mailbox
    Given an email to recovery mailbox "MBX-RECOVERY-01" with one PDF attachment "reply-0001.pdf"
    When the job runs
    Then one document_intake row has source "EMAIL", channel_code "MBX-RECOVERY-01" and the sender address recorded
    Then the system masks the sender address in every response and absent from the job record and the logs
    Then the email is in the archive folder of "MBX-RECOVERY-01"

  Scenario: AC4 Mailroom scan
    Given file "mailroom-0001.pdf" in the mailroom folder
    When the job runs
    Then one document_intake row has source "SCAN" and channel_code "MAILROOM"

  Scenario: AC5 A file type not allowed is refused
    Given file "letter-0002.docx" in the scanner folder of branch "BR-0123"
    When the job runs
    Then the system writes no document_intake row for it
    Then the file is in the rejected folder of branch "BR-0123"
    Then the job record shows 1 refused on "BR-0123" with MSG-P5-007 and reason MSG-P5-001

  Scenario: AC6 A file above the size limit is refused
    Given file "scan-0003.pdf" of 25.1 MB and file "scan-0004.pdf" of 25.0 MB in the scanner folder of branch "BR-0123"
    When the job runs
    Then the system refuses "scan-0003.pdf" with reason MSG-P5-017 and moved to the rejected folder
    Then "scan-0004.pdf" has a document_intake row

  Scenario: AC7 An unknown or suspended partner is refused
    Given file "notice-0005.pdf" in the SFTP subfolder "LF-099", which is no partner_code
    Given file "notice-0006.pdf" in the SFTP subfolder "LF-008", a partner with panel_status "SUSPENDED"
    When the job runs
    Then the system writes no document_intake row for either file
    Then the job record shows MSG-P5-007 with reasons "PARTNER_UNKNOWN" and "PARTNER_NOT_ACTIVE"

  Scenario: AC8 A duplicate file is not taken in twice
    Given file "scan-0001.pdf" with hash "H1" from branch "BR-0123" was taken in on 30 November
    When the same file arrives again from branch "BR-0123" on 2 December
    Then the system writes no second document_intake row
    Then the system moves the file to the processed folder and counted as a duplicate

  Scenario: AC9 An empty run
    Given no new file or email on any channel
    When the job runs
    Then the job record shows intakeStep complete with 0 items on each channel

  Scenario: AC10 The intake container does not accept writes
    Given the intake container refuses writes
    When the job runs with file "scan-0007.pdf" in the folder of branch "BR-0123"
    Then the system writes no document_intake row
    Then "scan-0007.pdf" stays in the scanner folder
    Then on the next run with the container available the file is taken in

  Scenario: AC11 Two failed runs raise an alert
    Given the run at 10:00 failed because the SFTP inbound folder could not be read
    When the run at 10:15 fails for the same reason
    Then the platform administrator receives MSG-P5-008 naming "PARTNER_SFTP"
    Then the run at 10:30 tries again

  Scenario: AC12 The job runs once across two instances
    Given two service instances are running
    When the 09:15 run is due
    Then the system records one run for 09:15
    Then each file has one document_intake row

  Scenario: AC13 An email with no usable attachment
    Given an email to "MBX-RECOVERY-01" with no attachment
    Given an email with only a 6 KB signature image
    When the job runs
    Then the system writes no document_intake row for either email
    Then both emails are in the archive folder

  Scenario: AC14 A file seen again after a failed move
    Given file "scan-0008.pdf" was taken in at 11:00 and the move to the processed folder failed
    When the run at 11:15 sees "scan-0008.pdf" again
    Then the system writes no second document_intake row
    Then the system moves the file to the processed folder

  Scenario: AC15 Outside business hours
    Given the time is 18:15 on a working day
    When the scheduler checks JOB-12
    Then no run starts until 08:00 the next working day

  Scenario: AC16 An item taken in is scanned before OCR
    Given file "scan-0009.pdf" was taken in by intakeStep with an empty scan_result
    When ocrStep runs in the same job before scanStep has set scan_result
    Then ocrStep does not read "scan-0009.pdf"
    Then after scanStep sets scan_result "CLEAN" ocrStep reads it

column2: Agent platform set-up [E1a]
column3:
Feature: Agent platform set-up [E1a]

  Background:
    Given the test agent "ECHO" has policy version "P1" approved with model "MODEL-A-2026-10", timeout 60 seconds, confidence floor 0.80 and allowed tools "read_case"
    Given prompt version "PR1" is approved for agent "ECHO"
    Given the model endpoint stub answers in 1,200 milliseconds with 900 input tokens and 150 output tokens
    Given the policy price is 0.0500 baht per 1,000 tokens

  Scenario: AC1 Approved endpoint
    Given the approved model endpoint on the private endpoint of the SCB tenant
    When the orchestrator runs agent "ECHO" for case "RW-2026-000101"
    Then the call succeeds with run status "ANSWERED"
    Then one agent run row holds agent "ECHO", policy version "P1", prompt version "PR1", model version "MODEL-A-2026-10", latency 1,200 ms, tokens in 900, tokens out 150 and cost 0.0525 baht
    Then the system writes one AgentRunCompleted event to the outbox with the run ID, agent "ECHO", the case ID, outcome "ANSWERED" and fallback false

  Scenario: AC2 Prompt versions
    Given prompt version "PR1" is in force for agent "ECHO"
    When RW-COE loads prompt version "PR2" and RW-RISK approves it with valid from 2026-11-20
    Then prompt version "PR2" exists with status "APPROVED"
    Then prompt version "PR1" stays readable through GET /admin/agent-configs with its text hash unchanged
    Then a run on 2026-11-19 uses "PR1" and a run on 2026-11-20 uses "PR2"

column2: Outbox and retry for outbound work
column3:
Feature: Outbox and retry for outbound work

  Background:
    Given consumer "win-dispatch" takes work request WIN_DISPATCH, holds the case step and has owner role RW-PLATADM
    Given consumers "ledger" and "reporting-feed" take CaseAllocated, CaseTransferred and CaseStateChanged, do not hold the case step and have owner role RW-PLATADM
    Given the retry settings are 3 retries at 1, 5 and 15 minutes after the previous attempt
    Given case "RW-2026-000601" has notice "NT-SYN-0601" waiting for approval

  Scenario: AC1 Sent after commit
    Given a notice approved
    When the transaction commits at 14 December 2026 10:00:00
    Then the outbox holds one WIN_DISPATCH request for case "RW-2026-000601" with one delivery for "win-dispatch"
    Then the header holds the event ID, idempotency key "WIN_DISPATCH:NT-SYN-0601", schema version 1, occurred time and actor
    Then the payload holds notice and case references only, with no name, address or identifier
    Then at the 10:01 run the sender delivers it and "win-dispatch" passes the notice to OutboundFiles.enqueue for the day's WIN file
    Then the delivery has status DELIVERED

  Scenario: AC2 Retry limit
    Given a target down for longer than the retry limit
    When "win-dispatch" fails at 10:01, 10:02, 10:07 and 10:22
    Then the system makes no fifth attempt
    Then the item moves to the exception queue: the "win-dispatch" delivery has status EXCEPTION and attempt count 4
    Then the system raises task RESOLVE_OUTBOX_DELIVERY on case "RW-2026-000601" for role RW-PLATADM
    Then event RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED moves the case to EXCEPTION_QUEUE by R-UNI-36 with one decision log entry

  Scenario: AC3 Nothing is sent for a change that did not commit
    Given the notice approval fails after OutboxWriter.publish and the transaction rolls back
    When the sender runs
    Then no event and no delivery exist for "NT-SYN-0601"

  Scenario: AC4 A retry that succeeds
    Given "win-dispatch" fails at 10:01 and the case moves to RETRY_QUEUE by R-UNI-33
    When the attempt at 10:02 succeeds
    Then the system delivers the delivery status with attempt count 2
    Then event RETRY_SUCCEEDED returns the case to the state it paused in by R-UNI-35

  Scenario: AC5 The same event is written once
    Given the approval of "NT-SYN-0601" is submitted twice with idempotency key "WIN_DISPATCH:NT-SYN-0601"
    When both transactions commit
    Then the outbox holds one event with that key
    Then the second transaction receives DuplicateOutboxKeyException and changes nothing

  Scenario: AC6 Two sender instances
    Given 200 due deliveries and two service instances
    When JOB-11 runs on both at 10:01
    Then the system makes each delivery once
    Then the delivery log holds 200 calls

  Scenario: AC7 Order per case and consumer
    Given event CaseTransferred with case sequence 11 and event CaseStateChanged with case sequence 12 for case "RW-2026-000601"
    Given the "ledger" consumer fails on sequence 11
    When the sender runs
    Then the system does not deliver sequence 12 to "ledger" until sequence 11 is DELIVERED

  Scenario: AC8 Consumers are independent
    Given event CaseAllocated for case "RW-2026-000601"
    When "ledger" fails and "reporting-feed" succeeds at 10:01
    Then the system delivers the "reporting-feed" delivery and the "ledger" delivery is RETRYING with next attempt 10:02
    Then the case route state does not change, because "ledger" does not hold the case step

  Scenario: AC9 Sending an exception delivery again
    Given delivery "OBD-SYN-0001" has status EXCEPTION
    When the platform administrator sends it again
    Then the response is 200 with message MSG-GEN-005
    Then the delivery status is PENDING with attempt count 0 and due at the next run
    When the platform administrator sends delivery "OBD-SYN-0002" with status DELIVERED again
    Then the response is 409 with message MSG-P2-022

  Scenario: AC10 An event with no case
    Given an event with no case whose only consumer fails 4 times
    When the retries are used
    Then the delivery status is EXCEPTION
    Then the system sends an alert to the platform administrator within 15 minutes
    Then no task and no case event are raised

  Scenario: AC11 Retry settings come from configuration
    Given the retry delays are changed in the configuration service to 2, 10 and 30 minutes at 09:00
    When "ledger" fails at 10:01
    Then the next attempt is due at 10:03

column2: Scheduled jobs on Quartz
column3:
Feature: Scheduled jobs on Quartz

  Background:
    Given two service instances "ACE-1" and "ACE-2" share the clustered Quartz job store
    Given the COLLINS load for business date 2026-12-02 passed its checks at 05:20 and JOB-02 succeeded at 05:50

  Scenario: AC1 Runs once
    When the morning allocation is due for business date 2026-12-02
    Then JOB-03 runs once, on one of the two instances
    Then the system logs its run with job "JOB-03", business date 2026-12-02, instance, start, end, status "SUCCEEDED" and the case counts

  Scenario: AC2 Missed run
    Given both instances were down from 04:30 to 09:40 on 2026-12-02
    When the service restarts at 09:40
    Then JOB-03 and JOB-04 run for business date 2026-12-02 after JOB-02 succeeds for that date
    Then the system logs each run with MSG-P3-030 naming the job and 2026-12-02

  Scenario: AC3 Repeated run for the same date
    Given JOB-03 succeeded for business date 2026-12-02
    When JOB-03 is fired again for 2026-12-02
    Then the system allocates no case again
    Then the run log records a skip for JOB-03 and 2026-12-02

  Scenario: AC4 Timer check does not overlap
    Given a JOB-05 run that started at 10:00 takes 7 minutes
    When the 10:05 fire is due
    Then the 10:05 run starts only after the 10:00 run ends
    Then no two JOB-05 runs are in progress at the same time

  Scenario: AC5 Several missed dates
    Given COLLINS loads passed for business dates 2026-12-02, 2026-12-03 and 2026-12-04 while both instances were down
    When the service restarts on 2026-12-04 at 11:00
    Then JOB-03 runs for 2026-12-02, then 2026-12-03, then 2026-12-04
    Then the system logs each run with its business date

  Scenario: AC6 More missed dates than the limit
    Given 7 business dates with passed COLLINS loads and no JOB-03 run
    When the service restarts
    Then no automatic catch-up run starts
    Then an alert with MSG-P3-031 names JOB-03 and the 7 dates

  Scenario: AC7 Dependency not met
    Given JOB-02 failed for business date 2026-12-03
    When JOB-03 is due for 2026-12-03
    Then JOB-03 does not run and its run is recorded "WAITING" with MSG-P3-031 naming "JOB-02"
    Then when JOB-02 succeeds for 2026-12-03 at 08:10 JOB-03 runs for 2026-12-03

  Scenario: AC8 Instance stops part way
    Given JOB-04 is running for 2026-12-02 on "ACE-1"
    When "ACE-1" stops
    Then "ACE-2" runs JOB-04 again for 2026-12-02 within the cluster check-in interval of 20 seconds
    Then the run log shows one "FAILED" run on "ACE-1" and one "SUCCEEDED" run on "ACE-2"

  Scenario: AC9 Allocation late
    Given JOB-03 for 2026-12-02 has not succeeded at 07:00
    When the deadline check runs at 07:00
    Then an alert with MSG-P3-031 naming JOB-03, 2026-12-02 and 07:00 reaches the operations channel by 07:15

  Scenario: AC10 Run book for every job
    Given the run book folder holds run books for JOB-03 and JOB-05 only
    When the build runs
    Then the build fails naming JOB-04

  Scenario: AC11 No new Quartz job holds a case wait
    Given a proposed job class "CaseReminderJob" that sleeps until a case reaches its next stage
    When the architecture test runs in the build
    Then the build fails and names "CaseReminderJob"
    Then JOB-05 passes the same test: it schedules, pauses, resumes and cancels timer rows through TimerScheduler and holds no wait on a case
    Then no Temporal schedule is registered in Epic 1 or Epic 2

column2: Decision log hash chain check
column3:
Feature: Decision log hash chain check

  Background:
    Given the environment is SIT with the synthetic decision log
    Given JOB-13 for business date 2 December 2026 ended at 01:40 on 3 December 2026

  Scenario: AC1 Chain intact
    Given the decision log holds 48,210 entries and none has been changed
    When JOB-14 runs at 02:00 on 3 December 2026
    Then the job run record shows type "JOB-14", business date 2 December 2026, status "COMPLETED" and result "INTACT"
    Then its checks hold entries checked 48,210, last chain_seq 48,210 and that entry's entry_hash
    Then MSG-P7-007 with the count and the last hash is sent to the Compliance group

  Scenario: AC2 Break
    Given the actions of the entry with chain_seq 30,005 were changed in the SIT database with the trigger disabled
    When JOB-14 runs
    Then the run result is "BROKEN" with first break chain_seq 30,005 and its entry ID
    Then the system raises an incident and MSG-P7-008 with the entry ID is sent to the Compliance group before 08:00 on 3 December 2026

  Scenario: AC3 A run that stops is reported
    Given the database connection is closed in the test double after 20,000 entries
    When JOB-14 runs
    Then the run status is "FAILED" with entries checked 20,000
    Then the system alerts the platform administrator group
    Then the system sends MSG-P7-013 to the Compliance group with the date of the last complete check, 2 December 2026

  Scenario: AC4 A rerun gives a new record and no second scheduled run
    Given JOB-14 for business date 2 December 2026 failed at 02:20
    When test user "U-9301" holding RW-PLATADM reruns it from the job monitor at 08:30
    Then a second run record for business date 2 December 2026 is written with rerun true
    Then the system marks the report to Compliance as a rerun
    Then while the rerun is running a second start of JOB-14 is refused by the scheduler

  Scenario: AC5 An empty log is intact
    Given the decision log holds no entry
    When JOB-14 runs
    Then the result is "INTACT" with entries checked 0 and last hash of 64 zeros

  Scenario: AC6 The job waits for the decision log copy
    Given JOB-13 for business date 2 December 2026 is still running at 02:00 and ends at 02:25
    When JOB-14 fires at 02:00
    Then it starts the check at 02:25 and records the JOB-13 end time
    Then if JOB-13 has not ended by 04:00 the check starts at 04:00 with the note "JOB-13 not ended"

  Scenario: AC7 Several changed entries
    Given the entries with chain_seq 12,001 and 40,350 were changed in the SIT database
    When JOB-14 runs
    Then the first break is chain_seq 12,001 and the failing count is 2
    Then one incident and one MSG-P7-008 report name both entry IDs

  Scenario: AC8 Entries written during the run
    Given the log holds 48,210 entries when JOB-14 starts
    Given 37 entries are appended while it runs
    When the run ends
    Then entries checked is 48,210 and last chain_seq is 48,210
    Then the next night's run checks 48,247 entries

column2: PDPA lint for code, tests and logs

column2: Document storage containers
column3:
Feature: Document storage containers

  Background:
    Given the SIT storage account has containers "rwb-intake", "rwb-docs", "rwb-docs-legal" and "rwb-quarantine"
    Given "rwb-docs-legal" has a time-based immutability policy of 3650 days

  Scenario: AC1 Write-once
    Given court notice "DOC-0701" stored at "rwb-docs-legal/RW-2026-000701/DOC-0701/v1" with hash "H701"
    When a client using the ACE service managed identity tries to overwrite it
    Then storage refuses the write with "BlobImmutableDueToPolicy"
    Then the blob hash is still "H701"
    Then the attempt is in the audit log with the identity and the time
    Then DocumentStore.replaceContent for "DOC-0701" raises WriteOnceViolationException, shown as 409 with MSG-P5-002

  Scenario: AC2 Delete is refused
    Given court notice "DOC-0701" in "rwb-docs-legal"
    When a client using the ACE service managed identity tries to delete it
    Then storage refuses the delete
    Then the blob is still readable

  Scenario: AC3 A new blob in the write-once container is allowed
    Given court notice "DOC-0701" at "v1" in "rwb-docs-legal"
    When the ACE service identity writes "rwb-docs-legal/RW-2026-000701/DOC-0701/v2"
    Then the write succeeds and both "v1" and "v2" are readable

  Scenario: AC4 The standard container keeps earlier versions
    Given "rwb-docs/RW-2026-000702/DOC-0702/v1" holds an appraisal report
    When the blob is overwritten by the ACE service identity in SIT
    Then the previous blob version is still readable through blob versioning
    Then a deleted blob can be restored within the 30 days of soft delete

  Scenario: AC5 The identities hold only their roles
    Given the role assignments applied by the template in SIT
    When the assignments are listed
    Then the ACE service identity holds Storage Blob Data Contributor on "rwb-intake", "rwb-docs" and "rwb-docs-legal" only
    Then "RWB-SIT-SY-OCR" holds Storage Blob Data Contributor on "rwb-intake", "rwb-docs" and "rwb-quarantine" only

  Scenario: AC6 Key-based access is refused
    Given the storage account has shared key access disabled
    When a client calls "rwb-docs" with the account key or with a shared access signature
    Then storage refuses the request with "KeyBasedAuthenticationNotPermitted"
